name: dougs-ai-tools
description: Small, independent tools for Claude Code and similar coding agents.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write one Markdown file at the end of a coding session so a fresh session can continue the work.

plugins.description: Experimental. Resume from a handoff without pasting its path: shows which handoff it chose and why before loading it. Requires handoff.
